purpose: Cross-corpus early-text benchmark for 女X structure, occurrence splitting, role extraction, reading variants, genealogy, and sex uncertainty. Prevents the model from equating 女+core-name with any one sex, cult, clan, or deity family.
epistemic_rules: Surface 女 never directly determines sex.
A reading/transmission variant does not by itself establish historical identity beyond the textual witness relation.
Same-name occurrences remain distinct nodes until independent evidence supports a merge.
Maternal-line genealogy is an attested structure, not a universal semantic value of 女.

cases.early_commentary: 王逸注：女歧，神女，无夫而生九子也。

cases.guard: Same surface name does not prove one person or two. Preserve occurrences and test transmission/commentary models.

cases.source: 说文解字·女部（引甘氏星经）
cases.text: 甘氏星经曰：太白上公，妻曰女媊。女媊居南斗，食厉，天下祭之，曰明星。

cases.guard: A raw 女+one-CJK regex catches this; it must not enter an entity census.

cases.source: 史记·秦本纪 / 史记索隐
cases.text: 女脩织，玄鸟陨卵，女脩吞之，生子大业。
evidence: 索隐：其父不著，而秦赵以母族而祖颛顼

cases.text: 大业取少典之子，曰女华。女华生大费。
cases.guard: 子 in 少典之子 is not male-only.

cases.text: 恶来革有子曰女防，女防生旁皋。
cases.guard: 有子曰 is insufficient for sex inference; compare 女华 in the same chapter.

cases.source: 左传·哀公元年 / 经典释文
cases.guard: Do not set sex=female from 女.

cases.text: 世子少康使汝艾伐过杀浇。

variant_relations.evidence: Later transmission explicitly glosses 媊音前; historical source spelling remains 女媊.
经典释文: 女如字又音汝; 竹书纪年 tradition: 汝艾.

pro: reported phonological argument linking 艾 and 岐
contra: Su Xuelin explicitly rejects the identification
Jinian narrative as transmitted distinguishes 汝艾 and 女歧 as separate actors

model_implication: 女+core graph is cross-tradition and semantically heterogeneous. Wa classification requires independent geography, ritual, hydrology, iconography, phonology, genealogy, or textual-provenance evidence; sex and maternal-line semantics must also be independently evidenced.
